Container: Scenario, Model,

span.p:
Component: Scenario Compiler
Resolves versions, dependencies, clocks, and study profile

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: Lifecycle Manager
Instantiate, initialize, run, stop, and clean up

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: Contract Validator
Checks schema, units, sign, range, ownership, and clock compatibility

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: Multi-rate Scheduler
Computes safe grants from requested times and next events

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: Superdense Event Queue
Orders simultaneous discrete events without inventing elapsed time

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: Coupling Manager
Resolves PCC and other feedback loops at communication points

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: State and Checkpoint Manager
Snapshots participants when their capabilities permit

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: Transport Gateway
Maps logical exchanges to HELICS, FMI, IPC, or process calls

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: Run Supervisor
Timeouts, non-convergence, participant failure, and deterministic abort

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Component: Provenance Recorder
Records grants, events, conversions, iterations, and model hashes

HELICS, FMI 3.0, hybrid, or custom transport
